components.gap: Composite: D-P3-006-GOAL-01, GOAL-02 and GOAL-03 are each partial; every explicitly listed bounded subcomponent must be supplied at its required standing before the composite goal is met.

The catalog must specify the constants convention of the two-variable and guarded input languages: the FO2 row (214-216) and GF row (227-230) state function-symbol and equality conventions but are silent on individual constants, which the P9 presentations treat as admitted (n-c-006.tex 71; n-c-007.tex 67-68). Functions, equality and prefix restrictions are otherwise stated for all four rows.

The finite-model statement for the monadic class is absent: the monadic row gives decidability and NEXPTIME/coNEXPTIME-completeness but no finite-model property or model-size bound, while the FO2, GF and EPR rows give theirs.

Each row names a source, but only the EPR row names its algorithm (finite grounding); the monadic, FO2 and GF rows are not linked to their actual decision algorithms (the handbook's FO2 and GF algorithm presentations sec:p09-presentation-n-c-006 and sec:p09-presentation-n-c-007 are not referenced from the catalog, and no monadic algorithm is linked). The catalog is not connected to P14: sec:p02-decidable-fragments contains no reference to tab:p14-dc-finite or any other P14 surface; only P14 points back to the catalog.
